Container.Name: wake-clip-keeper
Container.Overview:
Keeps Home Assistant Assist debug recordings small, with nothing to manage.
With the wake word running in Home Assistant (openWakeWord), every run's 00_wake WAV holds everything streamed while waiting for the wake word, often hundreds of MB. Once a run folder stops changing, this saves the last few seconds of the wake WAV (the audio that triggered it) and the speech-to-text WAV into the Clips folder, then deletes the original. Old clips are removed after Keep Days, or oldest first beyond Max Clips MB.
Before the first start, download the script (otherwise Docker creates an empty folder and the container exits): mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/wake-clip-keeper && wget -O /mnt/user/appdata/wake-clip-keeper/wake_clip_keeper.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adman234/-other/claude/affectionate-allen-7amx8d/unraid/wake-clip-keeper/wake_clip_keeper.py
Clips are named date-time_device_wake.wav / _stt.wav. Every wake clip is a detection: if nobody said the wake word, it is a false trigger and makes good negative training data.
Container.Requires: Home Assistant with assist_pipeline: debug_recording_dir set to a folder on an Unraid share.

Config.Name: HA Debug Recordings
Config.Description: The host folder Home Assistant's debug_recording_dir points to (the folder that contains the per-device folders, which contain the run folders with 00_wake / 01_stt WAVs). Its run folders are deleted after clipping.

Config.Name: Clips
Config.Description: Where the small clips go. Keep this OUTSIDE the HA Debug Recordings folder.

Config.Name: Wake Clip Seconds
Config.Description: Seconds kept from the end of each wake word recording.

Config.Name: Keep Days
Config.Description: Clips older than this are deleted.

Config.Name: Max Clips MB
Config.Description: Total size cap for the Clips folder; the oldest clips go first.

Config.Name: Host Time Zone
Config.Description: Uses the Unraid server's time zone for clip names.

Config.Name: Max STT Seconds
Config.Description: Cap for the speech-to-text clips (they are normally a few seconds).

Config.Name: Settle Seconds
Config.Description: A run folder is processed once none of its files has changed for this long.
